name: @ospm/eslint-plugin-react-unhookify
description: ESLint plugin to remove React hooks (useMemo, useCallback) and memo HOC for cleaner React code

scripts.deploy: bun run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:esm && bun run postbuild:esm && bun run build:types
scripts.build:watch: bun run build:cjs -- --watch & bun run build:esm -- --watch & bun run build:types -- --watch
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:all-rules
scripts.test:all-rules: bun run test:remove-use-memo && bun run test:remove-use-callback && bun run test:remove-memo
scripts.test:all-rules:simple: bun run test:remove-use-memo:simple && bun run test:remove-use-callback:simple && bun run test:remove-memo:simple
scripts.test:remove-use-memo: cd tests/remove-use-memo && bun x eslint --config eslint.config.mjs *.tsx
scripts.test:remove-use-memo:simple: cd tests/remove-use-memo && bun x eslint --config simple.config.mjs *.tsx
scripts.test:remove-use-callback: cd tests/remove-use-callback && bun x eslint --config eslint.config.mjs *.tsx
scripts.test:remove-use-callback:simple: cd tests/remove-use-callback && bun x eslint --config simple.config.mjs *.tsx
scripts.test:remove-memo: cd tests/remove-memo && bun x eslint --config eslint.config.mjs *.tsx
scripts.test:remove-memo:simple: cd tests/remove-memo && bun x eslint --config simple.config.mjs *.tsx
scripts.test:fix: bun run build && bun run test:fix:all-rules
scripts.test:fix:all-rules: bun run test:fix:remove-use-memo && bun run test:fix:remove-use-callback && bun run test:fix:remove-memo
scripts.test:fix:all-rules:simple: bun run test:fix:remove-use-memo:simple && bun run test:fix:remove-use-callback:simple && bun run test:fix:remove-memo:simple
scripts.test:fix:remove-use-memo: cd tests/remove-use-memo && bun x eslint --config eslint.config.mjs --fix *.tsx
scripts.test:fix:remove-use-memo:simple: cd tests/remove-use-memo && bun x eslint --config simple.config.mjs --fix *.tsx
scripts.test:fix:remove-use-callback: cd tests/remove-use-callback && bun x eslint --config eslint.config.mjs --fix *.tsx
scripts.test:fix:remove-use-callback:simple: cd tests/remove-use-callback && bun x eslint --config simple.config.mjs --fix *.tsx
scripts.test:fix:remove-memo: cd tests/remove-memo && bun x eslint --config eslint.config.mjs --fix *.tsx
scripts.test:fix:remove-memo:simple: cd tests/remove-memo && bun x eslint --config simple.config.mjs --fix *.tsx
